- The Android app's picker now has the same selection features as the desktop:
  - A Pixel/AOSP choice on the setup wizard. Pixel replaces first boot with
    Google's wizard; AOSP keeps the ROM's own setup wizard and adds the Google
    account step to it
  - Expert mode, with a "keep ROM app" toggle on any package that would replace
    one of the ROM's own
- Desktop is identical to 0.4.2
